name: cache-thermo
description: Retro prompt-cache thermometer above the prompt, a cold-cache gate that shows what the next prompt will cost, and a break mode that keeps the cache warm.

cacheTtl.description: Prompt-cache TTL the thermometer counts down from when the engine has not reported one. auto: 1h on a subscription, 5m on an API key.
cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL

gateThresholdUsd.description: Show the cold-cache gate only when the estimated re-cache cost is at least this many dollars. 0 gates every cold prompt.
gateThresholdUsd.title: Gate threshold (USD)

warnFraction.description: The band turns yellow when the remaining TTL is at or below this fraction.
warnFraction.title: Warn fraction

keepWarmLeadSeconds.description: On a break, refresh the cache when this many seconds remain.
keepWarmLeadSeconds.title: Keep-warm lead (seconds)

maxBreakHours.description: Stop keeping the cache warm after a break this long.
maxBreakHours.title: Max break (hours)

inputPriceOverrideUsdPerMTok.description: When above 0, replaces the shipped input price per million tokens for the current model.
inputPriceOverrideUsdPerMTok.title: Input price override ($/MTok)

showCostOnSubscription.description: Show API-equivalent dollar figures on a subscription account; off shows tokens only.
showCostOnSubscription.title: Show cost on subscription
